*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif}
:root{--e:#0b7a4b;--ed:#065f38;--el:#e8f6ef;--ink:#12241c;--gold:#c9a24b}
body{color:var(--ink);line-height:1.6}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
header{position:sticky;top:0;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.06);z-index:50}
.nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 0}
.logo{font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--ed);letter-spacing:1px}
.logo span{color:var(--gold)}
.btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--e);color:#fff;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:40px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;transition:.2s}
.btn:hover{background:var(--ed)}
.btn.wa{background:#25d366}
.hero{background:linear-gradient(rgba(4,40,25,.72),rgba(4,40,25,.72)),url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1517248135467-4c7edcad34c4?w=1600&q=70') center/cover;color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:90px 20px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,3.2rem);margin-bottom:12px}
.hero p{font-size:1.15rem;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto 26px;opacity:.92}
.cta-row{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
section{padding:64px 0}
h2{text-align:center;font-size:1.9rem;color:var(--ed);margin-bottom:8px}
.sub{text-align:center;color:#5a6f64;margin-bottom:36px}
.grid{display:grid;gap:20px;grid-template-columns:1fr}
.card{background:var(--el);border-radius:14px;padding:26px;text-align:center}
.card .ic{font-size:2rem}
.card h3{color:var(--ed);margin:8px 0 6px}
@media(min-width:760px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
.reviews{background:var(--el)}
.rev{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}
.stars{color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:2px}
.rev p{font-style:italic;margin:8px 0}
.rev b{color:var(--ed)}
.quote{background:var(--ed);color:#fff;text-align:center}
.quote blockquote{font-size:clamp(1.2rem,3vw,1.7rem);font-style:italic;max-width:700px;margin:0 auto}
.quote cite{display:block;margin-top:14px;color:var(--gold);font-style:normal;font-weight:700}
